instruction.text: Match each cause with its effect.

hint.text: A cause is why something happens and an effect is what happens. A cause always happens before an effect.

atoms.b: There is a snow day at school.
atoms.sound: There is a snow day at school because it snowed today.

atoms.b: We go on a lot of walks.
atoms.sound: We go on a lot of walks because we have a new puppy.
We cleaned the house because we are having guests.

instruction.text: Match each cause with its effect.

hint.text: A cause is why something happens and an effect is what happens. A cause always happens before an effect.

atoms.sound: I made the house dirty because my shoes were muddy.
My trousers are too short because I grew four inches.

atoms.b: We took him to the vet.
atoms.sound: We took our cat to the vet because he was porly.

instruction.text: Match each cause with its effect.

hint.text: A cause is why something happens and an effect is what happens. A cause always happens before an effect.

atoms.sound: I got new glasses because I have trouble seeing.
I brought my friend flowers because she is sad.

atoms.b: I drank a glass of water.
atoms.sound: I drank a glass of water because I was thirsty.

instruction.text: Match each cause with its effect.

atoms.sound: I am happy because I made a new friend.
I broke a plate because I am clumsy.
The cat had a nap because the cat was sleepy.
